titre: Rings of Power Renewed By Amazon For Season 4
chapo: Rings of Power season 3 has just wrapped up, but the show has just been renewed for season 4 at Prime Video.
extrait: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 wraps up later tonight, but the show has already been renewed for Season 4 at Prime Video. Amazon MGM has renewed Rings of Power just as the show has wrapped up its third season, according to a report from Variety. The new season will continue the show's exploration of Middle-earth's second age, and will begin filming in spring 2027, though no release date has been announced yet. While the show has been divisive for Tolkien fans, Amazon MGM's head of global television, Peter Friedlander, tells Variety that, "The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power has become a defining series for Prime Video." He also says that after the finale of Season 3 delivered "the landmark moment fans have been waiting for," the studio looks forward to "bringing fans even deeper into the rich world of Tolkien's Second Age." Thus far, the third season seems to be an improvement. Here at IGN, we gave the last three episodes of the show a 7 out of 10, with reviewer Jim Vejvoda saying, "The Rings of Power loses some forward momentum this week with two very talky episodes where several characters are literally waiting around for something to happen." However, the first half of the season was much stronger, with Jim giving the first four episodes an 8, saying "The Rings of Power Season 3, Episodes 1-4 prove a welcome return to Middle-earth, allowing the series to get back on track after two seasons of wandering." However, as the show nears the war that ends the Second Age of Middle-earth, it's going to be interesting to see where the showrunners take Rings of Power next season. There is a good chunk of time between the forging of the One Ring and the War of the Last Alliance that kicked off the Third Age, but no matter where they go with it, it'll likely involve the expanding influence of Sauron.
